title: ZKC Published Verifier Trust Policy v1
description: A verifier's PUBLISHED trust policy, for discovery only. Trust decisions remain verifier-local: the policy is authored and enforced by the verifier itself, and it may trust issuers that appear in no registry (trust is by key, never by registry membership — Freedom Safeguard 1).

acceptedProofTypes.description: Proof types this verifier accepts. NON-EXCLUSIVE and verifier-chosen; may include types defined outside this repository.

requiredReviewStatuses.description: Predicate-registry review statuses this verifier requires (verifier-local). Empty means the verifier imposes no review-status requirement. The list is matched exactly: a policy listing only 'reviewed' rejects a 'self_attested' entry, because self-attestation is not independent review. A verifier with real exposure SHOULD require 'reviewed'.

trustedIssuers.description: Key-exact issuer allowlist. Entries reference issuers BY KEY, not by registry membership: issuers outside registry/issuers/ are first-class here. An empty list trusts nobody (fail closed).

acceptsOutOfRegistryIssuers.description: Documentation flag: whether this verifier's allowlist (now or in the future) includes issuers not published in registry/issuers/. Informational only — trust is always decided by the key-exact allowlist above.

requiredContextProfile.description: Required proof-context profile, or empty for no requirement.

maxEpochLag.description: Maximum accepted accumulator epoch lag (may only tighten the protocol bound).

proofRequirements.description: OPTIONAL published per-predicate minimums for minimal-disclosure planning. When present this is the COMPLETE statement of the verifier's need: each listed proof type (which must also appear in acceptedProofTypes) maps to the minimum parameters the verifier requires, and holders treat requests beyond these minimums as overbroad. Discovery only — enforcement stays verifier-local.
